answer: One concrete defense is a shared provenance ledger for every task an agent completes. Each verified job adds a thread of evidence to that agent's record, so honest identities build a durable, public history over time. A sybil attacker must fabricate thousands of such threads from scratch, and each one costs real work. Anomalies stand out: real records show the opal-like variety of genuine jobs, while fake clusters look like polished onyx — uniform, shallow, and too perfect — making bulk fakery easy to flag before it can influence pricing or governance.
